limitations.note: The two-state rewrite preserves the original one-output-per-pair behavior instead of letting the counter reach 2 and emitting the second packed word on the third accepted byte.
The test expects no output on the third consecutive accepted byte, so even exhaustive byte-pair coverage validates the same assumption that hides the defect.

limitations.quote: For a stream packer whose counter wraps before the output decode can fire
limitations.note: The agent read guidance pointing to premature counter wrap, but the patch still discarded the unreachable output path rather than checking whether the wrap was the bug.
